title: Sage scene record
description: A scene record (SceneRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another scene record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

prefab.description: What to place. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)

at.description: Relative to the scene centre; y is height above the ground. Unit: m. (Vector3)

name.description: Optional, so ent_list can tell two copies apart. (string)

at.description: Relative to the scene centre; y is height above the ground. Unit: m. (Vector3)

name.description: Optional, so ent_list can tell two copies apart. (string)

place+.description: Adds to "place": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

prefab.description: What to place. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)

name.description: Optional, so ent_list can tell two copies apart. (string)

place-.description: Removes these from "place" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

maps.description: Brush levels to load with the scene. Names a map record. (List<RecordRef<MapRecord>>)

maps+.description: Adds to "maps": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

maps-.description: Removes these from "maps" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).
